question: Six boys P, Q, R, S, T and U are sitting around a circular table facing inside but not necessarily in same order. Two person sits between P and U and P sits immediate left of S. S sits opposite to T and sits second to right of R. Who sits opposite to R?
solution:
As per the information:

Six boys P, Q, R, S, T and U are sitting around a circular table facing inside but not necessarily in same order.

 
• **Two person sits between P and U and P sits immediate left of S.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d2c0b117d5b48554ae8357d1f2a79693bbf05caa2637670088e6cbca2a4733df.png] 

 
• **S sits opposite to T and sits second to right of R.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/be6255196bc48100778b7dfe3651fb01c492ae7fbe9b4080f33b069205c71107.png] 

Thus, the final arrangement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f888113c3313c4456502a2e3dd1b7ed152ba040d4e2f895b234f3f8f675af3e3.png] 

Clearly, 'Q' sits opposite to R.

Hence, the correct answer is "Q".
